metadata.question: Does the land surface temperature in the United Kingdom increase in February 11-25, 2019 compared to the same period average from 2000-2012?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
   - Dataset: MODIS Terra LST 8-day (MOD11A2) over the United Kingdom (USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017, country_na = "United Kingdom").
   - Periods:
     • Baseline: 2000–2012, Feb 11–25 (calendar filters on year, month=2, day_of_month=11..25).
     • Comparison: 2019, Feb 11–25 (same filters).
   - Fallback: If MOD11A2 is empty for either period, switch both periods to MOD11A1 (daily).
2. Masking strategy.
   - Use QC_Day bits 0–1 == 0 (good data) and LST_Day_1km > 0. Convert to Celsius using scale 0.02 and K→°C.
3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error.
   - Check collection sizes; if empty after fallback → C1.
   - Count valid pixels in composite; if 0 → C2.
   - Validate mean values: not null, within [-100, 100] °C; otherwise → C3.
   - If valid, compare 2019 mean vs. baseline mean; increase → A, else → B.
</thinking>

const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  // Helpers
  const getInfo = (obj) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => obj.getInfo(resolve, reject));
  const scale = 3000;
  const maxPixels = 1e13;

  // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
  const roi = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017')
    .filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'United Kingdom')).geometry();

  const month = 2;
  const startDay = 11;
  const endDay = 25;

  // Masking functions
  function prepA2(img) {
    const qa = img.select('QC_Day');
    const good = qa.bitwiseAnd(3).eq(0);
    const lstC = img.select('LST_Day_1km').multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15);
    return lstC.updateMask(good).updateMask(img.select('LST_Day_1km').gt(0)).rename('LST_C')
              .copyProperties(img, img.propertyNames());
  }
  function prepA1(img) {
    const qa = img.select('QC_Day');
    const good = qa.bitwiseAnd(3).eq(0);
    const lstC = img.select('LST_Day_1km').multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15);
    return lstC.updateMask(good).updateMask(img.select('LST_Day_1km').gt(0)).rename('LST_C')
              .copyProperties(img, img.propertyNames());
  }

  function filterPeriod(col, yStart, yEnd) {
    return col
      .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(yStart, yEnd, 'year'))
      .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(month, month, 'month'))
      .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(startDay, endDay, 'day_of_month'));
  }

  async function computeStats(datasetId, prepFn, yStart, yEnd) {
    const col = filterPeriod(ee.ImageCollection(datasetId), yStart, yEnd);
    const size = await getInfo(col.size());
    if (size === 0) return { size: 0, mean: null, valid: 0, datasetId };
    const lstCol = col.map(prepFn);
    const meanImg = lstCol.mean();
    const valid = await getInfo(meanImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: roi, scale: scale, maxPixels: maxPixels
    }).get('LST_C'));
    if (!valid || valid === 0) return { size, mean: null, valid: 0, datasetId };
    const mean = await getInfo(meanImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
      geometry: roi, scale: scale, maxPixels: maxPixels
    }).get('LST_C'));
    return { size, mean, valid, datasetId };
  }

  try {
    // Total pixel count at analysis scale
    const totalPix = await getInfo(ee.Image(1).rename('ones').reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: roi, scale: scale, maxPixels: maxPixels
    }).get('ones'));

    // Try primary dataset MOD11A2 for both periods
    let ds = { id: 'MODIS/006/MOD11A2', prep: prepA2 };
    let s2019 = await computeStats(ds.id, ds.prep, 2019, 2019);
    let sBase = await computeStats(ds.id, ds.prep, 2000, 2012);

    // Fallback to MOD11A1 if either is empty
    if (s2019.size === 0 || sBase.size === 0) {
      ds = { id: 'MODIS/006/MOD11A1', prep: prepA1 };
      s2019 = await computeStats(ds.id, ds.prep, 2019, 2019);
      sBase = await computeStats(ds.id, ds.prep, 2000, 2012);
      if (s2019.size === 0 || sBase.size === 0) {
        console.log(`Empty collections -> 2019:${s2019.size}, 2000-2012:${sBase.size}`);
        console.log('C1');
        return;
      }
    }

    // Check valid pixels after masking
    if (!totalPix || totalPix === 0 || s2019.valid === 0 || sBase.valid === 0) {
      console.log(`No valid pixels -> 2019:${s2019.valid}, 2000-2012:${sBase.valid}, total:${totalPix||0}`);
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // Validate means
    const m2019 = s2019.mean;
    const mBase = sBase.mean;
    if (m2019 === null || mBase === null || isNaN(m2019) || isNaN(mBase) ||
        m2019 < -100 || m2019 > 100 || mBase < -100 || mBase > 100) {
      console.log(`Invalid means -> 2019:${m2019}, 2000-2012:${mBase}`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // Evidence prints (<=20 lines)
    console.log(`Dataset: ${ds.id.split('/').pop()}`);
    console.log(`2019 imgs: ${s2019.size}, validPix: ${s2019.valid}/${totalPix} (${(s2019.valid/totalPix*100).toFixed(1)}%)`);
    console.log(`2019 LST mean (°C): ${m2019.toFixed(2)}`);
    console.log(`2000-2012 imgs: ${sBase.size}, validPix: ${sBase.valid}/${totalPix} (${(sBase.valid/totalPix*100).toFixed(1)}%)`);
    console.log(`2000-2012 LST mean (°C): ${mBase.toFixed(2)}`);
    console.log(`Diff (2019 - baseline) °C: ${(m2019 - mBase).toFixed(2)}`);

    // Final Answer
    const increased = (m2019 - mBase) > 0;
    console.log(increased ? 'A' : 'B');
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err && err.message ? err.message : err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
